title: MRR (normalized monthly recurring revenue)
definition: At the interval end (or each local day end with window): for every customer subscription whose latest billing event is active or past_due, the recurring price of its latest priced event times quantity, minus forever discounts and repeating discounts until they end, normalized to one month (annual/12, quarterly/3, weekly x52/12, daily x365/12, rounded half up per subscription), summed by native currency. Trials, free and metered prices contribute nothing; one-time discounts and refunds do not change MRR. delinquent_mrr is the past_due part.
source_contract: pr_subscription_events (057, Stripe webhook) via business_subscription_events + pr_subscriptions for paid subscriptions without any event
limitations: not_instrumented until the first real billing event. A paid subscription without a priced event (or with a discount, tiered, multi-item or tax-inclusive price that cannot be valued) is coverage.unknown, never its list price. Not collections, not recognized revenue.

title: Delinquent MRR
definition: The past_due part of mrr at the interval end (or each local day end): normalized monthly recurring value of customer subscriptions whose latest billing event is past_due, by native currency.
limitations: Stripe owns dunning attempts; 'grace' is never produced by Stripe and is not counted. Unpaid or cancelled subscriptions leave MRR.

title: MRR bridge (movements)
definition: Over [start, end): per customer (workspace, else subscription) and currency, opening MRR at start versus closing MRR at end. new (no MRR at start, never paid before), reactivation (paid before, none at start), expansion, contraction and churn (MRR at start, none at end) are signed net changes; opening and closing rows cover the same customers, so opening + movements = closing exactly. Without the movement dimension the value is the net movement.
source_contract: pr_subscription_events (057) via business_subscription_events; daily pr_subscription_snapshots to flag customers paid before their first event
limitations: insufficient_history until events cover a full month and reach back to the interval start. Net per customer: changes that offset inside the interval cancel out. Customers with unknown MRR at either end are excluded from every row and counted as coverage.unknown. The Demo dataset has no subscription-change history: Demo reports demo_not_simulated.

title: Paid customer churn
definition: Customers (workspaces) paying at the interval start (MRR > 0) whose MRR is zero at the end, divided by customers paying at the start. Numerator and denominator are reported.
limitations: Billing churn only: inactivity or account deletion is never churn. Same history rule as mrr_movements; no opening paying customers gives not_applicable. Demo reports demo_not_simulated.

title: Credits granted
definition: Sum of immutable credit grant entries in the usage ledger (meta.credits op grant) in the half-open interval, by grant source (subscription, purchase, goodwill, test, other) and plan.
limitations: not_instrumented while credits are off (POSTRIFF_CREDITS_ENABLED unset). Credits are a liability, not revenue. Reversals are not netted.

title: Credits consumed
definition: Sum of credits used by settled tasks (meta.credits op settle, used) in the half-open interval, by task type (the ledger feature) and plan.
source_contract: pr_usage_ledger meta.credits via business_credit_entries (063) and business_usage_v2 feature
limitations: Reservation is not consumption. not_instrumented while credits are off.

title: Available credits
definition: At the interval end: the existing wallet projection (credit_wallet.project_credit_wallet) per workspace over its credit ledger entries, after holds, expiry, reversals and debt, summed by plan; held and debt credits are reported as measures.
limitations: Reuses the consumer wallet projection, never a second balance formula. A workspace whose ledger the projection rejects is coverage.unknown. not_instrumented while credits are off; unavailable above 50,000 credit entries.

title: MRR forecast (scenario)
definition: Scenario, not a measurement: an ordinary least-squares line through the most recent (up to 90) daily MRR snapshot totals before the interval end, by native currency, extrapolated to each requested day (or the interval's last day); negative values floor at zero. measures.basis is 'scenario' and measures names the method, fit days and slope.
limitations: insufficient_history until 56 daily snapshot points exist per currency. A straight line is a scenario for discussion, not a prediction; it ignores seasonality, pricing changes and churn shocks.

title: Cash collected
definition: Sum of funded live-mode credit orders, live-mode paid invoices of every plan (pr_invoices.amount_paid at the paid event) and live-mode credit-plan invoice grants whose invoice is not in pr_invoices (deduplicated by invoice id), in the half-open interval, by native currency.
limitations: Partial: invoices issued before the 057 billing-event instrumentation were never stored and provider fees are not recorded; gross of refunds (see refunds_disputes).
